title: Does the measured candidate fit this device?
description: Use profiler observations and product limits to gate a candidate. The lab keeps model storage, runtime memory, and tail latency separate because one cannot predict the others.
measurementNote: Measure these on every supported hardware, OS, runtime, delegate, input-shape, and thermal cohort. A passing arithmetic envelope is permission to test further, not proof that the model is safe to release.

profiles.label: Budget phone sample
profiles.detail: Illustrative measurements expose a latency miss and a tight guarded memory ceiling.

profiles.label: Premium phone sample
profiles.detail: Illustrative measurements leave headroom, but do not stand in for thermal or quality tests.

profiles.label: Industrial gateway sample
profiles.detail: Illustrative measurements trade a larger envelope for a slower control-loop deadline.
